name: Canvas
description: A page of tiles you show or hide: Compute load (jobs on each compute node, free CPU and memory) and Agents (pick any agent to talk to in the Thread).

reasons.compute:nodes: to show how busy each of this server's compute nodes is: jobs running and queued, free CPU and memory, and whose jobs they are
reasons.agents:read: to list the agents you can reach, with their pictures and who's working, and show the one you pick in the Thread
reasons.thread:read: to show how many messages from each agent you haven't read
